description: Exceptions to the Segment pace check (scripts/lib/segment-pace.js, check:integrity rule implausible_pace, Import pace warnings): Segments whose median lap is flagged but is what was raced, e.g. a full-distance swim with or against a strong current, or a PRO-only Category compared with age-group Editions. One entry exempts exactly one Segment: { "event": Event id, "date": Edition date YYYY-MM-DD, "category": Category id, "segment": "<position> <sport>" as in the Segment column of bun scripts/report-segment-pace.js (e.g. "1 swim", "3 run"), "reason": why the pace is genuine, "source": URL of the race-day evidence }. Add an entry only when race-day evidence shows the declared distance was raced; a wrong distance is fixed in race-info.json instead. check:integrity fails on an entry that matches no measured Segment or whose Segment is no longer flagged.

entries.reason: Full 1.9 km swim in a strong current that made the buoys hard to find; the PRO winner swam 26:09. Slower than 2017/2018, when the course ran with the current.
